evidence.description: A stolen Hyundai Sonata was rammed into the front doors, wedged between the doors and bike stands near the sidewalk
Business security footage shows a large group outside, repeated attempts to break the doors, entry into the store and the group fleeing in two cars
Thousands of dollars of products and cash taken by a group of more than 10 people, a mix of young adults and children

unknowns: whether the two getaway cars were stolen
notes: Reported as just before 3:30 a.m.; 03:30 is the upper bound. FOX 13 was working with police to learn whether the two getaway cars were also stolen and gives no result. The owner said scr-01 was similar. The article gives no police answer on whether the two are related. No police statement links this incident to any other incident in the set.
